verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents HMAC-signed webhooks, dashboard/API-based webhook configuration, and a dedicated 'Resend webhooks' capability for replay, satisfying the signing and replay parts of the story. However, evidence does not confirm automatic system-driven retries of failed webhook deliveries (only manual resend) or a dedicated event log/audit trail view for webhook history. Missing for 10: documented automatic retry policy for undelivered webhooks, explicit event log/audit UI, independent confirmation of retry behavior.
